name: AirAsia
verdict: AirAsia roundel low on Port FC's 2026-27 home shirt; in Thailand the airline is Thai AirAsia, wholly owned by SET-listed Asia Aviation, whose largest holders are AirAsia Aviation Group (40.7%) and Tassapon Bijleveld (17.8%). Nothing found.
